## Summary

Describe the reader-facing or developer-facing change.

## Evidence

For factual or time-sensitive claims, link primary sources and state the date checked. Mark architecture claims about closed systems as documented, observed, inferred, or unknown.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] New and changed internal links resolve
- [ ] Code examples contain no real credentials or private data
- [ ] Provider versions, prices, limits, and legal claims cite current first-party sources
- [ ] Mobile layout and keyboard focus were checked when UI changed

## Impact

Explain which readers, pages, routes, or deployment behavior are affected.
